scope: The December 2011 Fort Christian exterior in Charlotte Amalie, including the four surviving bastions, weathered harbor walls, Gothic Revival entrance and clock tower, and the open courtyard. Nearby buildings, historic weapons, and museum interiors are outside the model.

originalReview.notes: December 2011 close photograph shows battered gray-white stonework, pale plaster parapet, round corner turret with a red accent, and green openings.
December 2011 harbor view shows the full width of the surviving waterfront elevation with white and stone walls, red accents and the raised north clock tower beyond.

quallaSearch.notes: Two exact published Qualla photographs taken in December 2011 were accepted. Smallbones released both originals under CC0.
